purpose: Accept NFC/HF/UHF RFID observations as identifier and presence evidence without coupling canonical asset identity or location state to a particular reader vendor.

android_nfc.role: foreground tap/near-field observation through a native Android companion when enabled

desktop_or_linux_reader.role: USB, serial, HID, SDK, or network reader adapter feeding the bounded M.I.R.R.O.R. service through a local agent

network_uhf_reader.role: fixed reader/antenna observations mapped to configured zones through an authenticated local or private-network adapter

reader_semantics.dedupe_scope: tag plus reader/antenna/zone within a configured observation window

allowed_only_when: deployment has an explicit zone/presence promotion policy
tag is uniquely bound to one active asset UUID
reader and zone identity are verified
canonical inventory authority write and readback succeed
location_promotion.manual_scan_override: A deliberate barcode/QR/NFC location move may outrank passive presence observations according to configured policy and provenance.
